report.collision_bundle_radius: At each sampled station: maximum actual evaluated conductor offset from centreline plus0.72mm insulation radius. report.strand_spacing_scope: Within each harness: minimum bidirectional sampled point-to-polyline distance at241 stations per conductor pair; insulation outside diameter1.44mm. Different harnesses and exhaustive continuous/self-contact cable dynamics are not covered by this metric.
report.screened_mesh_categories: Printed parts and official motor case meshes. Interior classification requires evaluated local bounds and majority of three independent ray-parity directions. Standard fastener meshes are covered by the separate mechanical auditor, not this TTL bundle screen.
report.limitation: Discrete kinematic route screen only; connector keying, plug fit, continuous swept collision, constant cable length, strain and flex life require physical checks.
